term: problem-of-evil use modes and remaining use
definition: For fixed Critic c and Rowe Sig s, OwnTruePremise c is c.Holds c.evilUtterance; AffectiveProtest c is c.ExpressesDisapproval c.evilUtterance; InternalPermissionChallenge s is the target-conditional defined separately. NamedUseCoverage is their disjunction. RemainingUse is the conjunction of their three negations. UseCoverageWithRemainder adds that remainder as a fourth branch and is proved from explicit excluded middle. EmotivistUseFork excludes OwnTruePremise and preserves the other three branches. NamedEmotivistAlternatives excludes OwnTruePremise and leaves only InternalPermissionChallenge or AffectiveProtest, conditionally on NamedUseCoverage.
note: These are semantic diagnostic conditions for one critic/target profile, not exclusive speech acts or an exhaustive list of worldviews. Internal challenge and protest overlap in the model. Coverage without the remainder is an explicit proposition and has a countermodel; no search history establishes it. The exact force called moot here is limited to inability to use this selected moral sentence as an own-true premise under the strict truthless policy; neither the occurrence of suffering, God's existence nor every internal criticism is decided.
